verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Homebrew's code is publicly hosted on GitHub (github.com/Homebrew/brew). Formulae are Ruby files in a homebrew-core repository, and taps are cloned GitHub repos, so the source is readable. No item in the pack states what license the code is under, so the 'open license' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any documentation of the license (e.g. a LICENSE file or license terms), and independent confirmation of open-source licensing for the core and formula repos.
